step1_analysis.description: A basic CMOS inverter circuit that outputs the logical complement of its input. In the context of the paper's high-speed multiplexer/demultiplexer ICs, it is likely used as a digital buffer, pre-amplifier stage, or basic logic gate.

paper_reference.title: 0.18-m CMOS 10-Gb/s Multiplexer/Demultiplexer ICs Using Current Mode Logic with Tolerance to Threshold Voltage Fluctuation

v_th.description: Switching threshold voltage where Vin = Vout

sky130_expected.calculation: With Wp=Wn=5um and Ln=Lp=0.5um, the NMOS is significantly stronger than the PMOS due to higher electron mobility (un ~ 3-4x up). Therefore, the switching threshold will be skewed below VDD/2 (0.9V).
sky130_expected.reasoning: NMOS drive strength dominates, pulling the switching threshold lower than the ideal midpoint.
Calculated using standard CV/I estimation for the NMOS discharging a 50fF load capacitor.
Calculated using standard CV/I estimation for the PMOS charging a 50fF load capacitor. Slower than fall time due to lower PMOS mobility.
Based on PMOS drive current charging the load capacitance.
Based on NMOS drive current discharging the load capacitance.

power_avg.description: Average power consumption at 1 GHz switching frequency

sky130_expected.calculation: Dynamic power P = C * VDD^2 * f = 50fF * (1.8V)^2 * 1GHz = 162 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dominated by dynamic switching power charging and discharging the 50fF load at 1 GHz.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure switching threshold, propagation delays, rise/fall times, and average power of the CMOS inverter.
step3_testbench.spice:
* CMOS Inverter Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u

XM1 Q D GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 Q D VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VGND GND 0 0
* 1 GHz input pulse for high-speed testing
VIN D 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0.2n 20p 20p 0.4n 1n)
* 50fF load capacitor to simulate fan-out/wiring
CL Q 0 50f

.control
* DC Analysis for Switching Threshold
dc VIN 0 1.8 0.01
meas dc v_th find v(D) when v(Q)=0.9

* Transient Analysis for Timing and Power
tran 2p 3n
meas tran t_pd_fall trig v(D) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(Q) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran t_pd_rise trig v(D) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(Q) val=0.9 rise=1
meas tran t_fall trig v(Q) val=1.44 fall=1 targ v(Q) val=0.36 fall=1
meas tran t_rise trig v(Q) val=0.36 rise=1 targ v(Q) val=1.44 rise=1

* Average Power Calculation
meas tran i_avg avg i(VVDD) from=0 to=3n
let power_avg = -i_avg * 1.8
print power_avg

quit
.endc
.end
